title: Prepositions for Location, Time and Method
objective: Students use prepositions accurately in laboratory and research descriptions.
phrases: The cells were observed under the microscope.
Growth was measured for seven days.
The difference between groups was small.
outcomes: Use in, on, at for location and time.
Use under, between, during, after, before in lab context.
Use with and by for method and instrument.
activity: Lab directions task: students describe where samples are, when they were measured, and how they were analyzed.
example: Prepositions are small but important: “under the microscope” sounds natural; “in the microscope” does not.
